title: Outpost weather.json
description: The weather data Outpost writes to /data/weather.json, format version 1. See docs/data-format.md.

$schema.description: This schema's address, for editors that check the file.

schema_version.description: Raised only for a change that breaks readers.

version.description: The Outpost version that wrote the file.

provider.description: The OUTPOST_PROVIDER setting, such as auto.

weather.description: Where the readings and forecast came from. null in an error file.

alerts.description: Where the alerts came from. null when the source has no official alerts.

fill.description: A second source used for readings the first one left empty. null when none was used.

timezone.description: The location's IANA time zone, such as Europe/Oslo, for showing times as they are there. null when unknown.

generated_at.description: When the data was last updated successfully (left unchanged while degraded). A service's answer can be reused for some minutes, so current.observed_at says how old the readings are.

temperature.description: Label for temperature, feels_like, dew_point, high, and low (also in hourly), such as °F.

speed.description: Label for wind_speed, such as mph.

pressure.description: Label for pressure, such as inHg.

distance.description: Label for visibility, such as mi.

precipitation.description: Label for precipitation amounts, such as in (added in Outpost 0.8.0).

wind_gust.description: The strongest gusts, in the speed unit. null when there are none or the source has none.

wind_direction.description: Where the wind comes from, in whole degrees clockwise from north (270 is a west wind). null when calm or not reported.

observed_at.description: When these readings are from: the station's observation time, or the start of the forecast hour for sources that forecast "now" (MET Norway). null when unknown.

precipitation.description: Rain or snow expected that day, as water, in the precipitation unit (added in Outpost 0.8.0). For today, from MET Norway, only what is still to come.

hourly.description: The next 24 hours, from the hour under way (added in Outpost 0.8.0; older files leave it out). Empty when the source has no hourly forecast.

precipitation.description: Rain or snow expected in that hour, as water, in the precipitation unit (added in Outpost 0.8.0).

wind_direction.description: Where the wind comes from, in whole degrees. null when calm or not given.

severity.description: extreme, severe, moderate, minor, or unknown (test in mock data).

onset.description: When it starts (added in Outpost 0.8.0). null when the source doesn't say.

name.description: The name to credit on the dashboard.

amount.description: A precipitation amount. null when not available.
